These pages hold project-specific evidence tasks. Add a task only when writing
or analysis needs evidence, a bounded comparison, or a claim boundary. They do
not duplicate source annotations, quotations, or claim extracts; those remain
canonical in [Notes](../../../notes/index.qmd).

> 本目录记录研究写作中出现的证据 task，不是按论文组织的文献表。原文条件、摘录、页码和可复用 claim 均以论文笔记为准。

- [Novelty and comparators](novelty-and-comparators.qmd)
- [Method audit](method-audit.qmd)
- [Mechanisms and boundaries](mechanisms.qmd)

## How to use the evidence tasks

Task starts in Literature map. Candidate papers enter
[Reading queue](../../../notes/reading-queue.md). Reviewed source facts and
claims enter a [Paper note](../../../notes/papers/index.md). Then add a scoped,
reusable claim with paper-note link and exact source location under task's
`Evidences`. One paper claim may support several tasks. A task stays open when
literature gives plausible story but not evidence matching manuscript wording.

> 工作流：Literature map 提出 task；Reading queue 列候选论文；Paper notes 保存审阅后的来源事实与 claim；最后把可支持 task 的、带适用范围的 claim 填回 `Evidences`。一条 claim 可服务多个 task。仅有合理叙事、不足以支撑手稿措辞时，task 保持 open。
